delete.description: Cancels an order by ID. Only orders with a status of `pending` can be cancelled — orders that have already shipped cannot be reversed.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The ID of the order to cancel.

409.description: Order cannot be cancelled — it has already shipped.

x-codeSamples.label: CLI

  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'

get.description: Returns current stock levels for all pets in the store.

x-codeSamples.label: CLI
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -L https://petstore.example.com/v1/inventory \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'

x-codeSamples.label: Fetch
Python

parameters.name: petId
parameters.description: The ID of the pet to update stock for.

x-codeSamples.label: CLI
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -L -X PATCH https://petstore.example.com/v1/inventory/1 \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"quantity": 5}'

x-codeSamples.label: Fetch
Python
x-codeSamples.source:
import requests
r = requests.patch(
    'https://petstore.example.com/v1/inventory/1',
    headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'},
    json={'quantity': 5}
)
print(r.json())

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all animals in the store. Use `limit` to control page size and `status` to filter by availability.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of animals to return. Defaults to 20, max 100.

x-codeSamples.label: CLI
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -L https://petstore.example.com/v1/pets \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'

x-codeSamples.label: Fetch
Python

post.description: Adds a new animal to the store. The `name` and `categoryId` fields are required.

x-codeSamples.label: CLI
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -L -X POST https://petstore.example.com/v1/pets \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name": "Goldie", "categoryId": 3, "status": "available"}'

x-codeSamples.label: Fetch
Python
x-codeSamples.source:
import requests
r = requests.post(
    'https://petstore.example.com/v1/pets',
    headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'},
    json={'name': 'Goldie', 'categoryId': 3, 'status': 'available'}
)
print(r.json())
